title: Block Tag Editor
description: Lets you edit block tags through simple config
body:
# `🏷️` Block Tag Editor - Modify Block Tags
Allows server administrators and developers to **add or remove blocks from [tags](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_tag_(Java_Edition))** through a simple YAML configuration file.

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CwA0yT8bxDE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## `✨` Features
* `➕` **Add Tags** - Add any block to existing block [tags](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_tag_(Java_Edition))
* `➖` **Remove Tags** - Remove blocks from specific [tags](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Block_tag_(Java_Edition))
* `📝` **Simple YAML Config** - Easy-to-use configuration file
* `⚡` **Bootstrap Level** - Modifies tags at the earliest loading stage
* `🎯` **Full Compatibility** - Works with datapacks and other plugins

---

## `🎮` Usage

### Configuration Example
```yaml
blocks:
  stone:
    remove_tags:
      - minecraft:mineable/pickaxe
    add_tags:
      - minecraft:needs_diamond_tool
  
  chain:
    add_tags: minecraft:climbable
```

### Common Use Cases
* **Custom Mining Tools** - Make blocks require specific tool types
* **Gameplay Modifications** - Change which blocks can be broken by certain tools
* **Datapack Integration** - Adjust vanilla tags without editing data files
